Name: Charizard Cat Replacer
Author: DonaldMcRoland123
Description:
How to install:
[b]
1. Locate the Stardew Valley folder.

2. Go to Stardew Valley folder.

3. Click the Content folder.

4. Go to Animals folder.

5. Replace the original file into the file you download.

[quote]Make sure that the original file and the downloaded file has the same name or else it won't work.﻿[/quote][/b]
